list.name: generate_image
list.description: Generate an image using DALL-E based on a text prompt

prompt.description: Text description of the desired image

model.description: DALL-E model to use (dall-e-2 or dall-e-3)

quality.description: Quality of the generated image (dall-e-3 only)

style.description: Style of the generated image (dall-e-3 only)

saveDir.description: Directory to save the generated images

fileName.description: Base filename for the generated images (without extension)

list.name: edit_image
list.description: Edit an existing image using DALL-E based on a text prompt

prompt.description: Text description of the desired edits

imagePath.description: Path to the image to edit

mask.description: Path to the mask image (white areas will be edited, black areas preserved)

model.description: DALL-E model to use (currently only dall-e-2 supports editing)

saveDir.description: Directory to save the edited images

fileName.description: Base filename for the edited images (without extension)

list.name: create_variation
list.description: Create variations of an existing image using DALL-E

imagePath.description: Path to the image to create variations of

model.description: DALL-E model to use (currently only dall-e-2 supports variations)

saveDir.description: Directory to save the variation images

fileName.description: Base filename for the variation images (without extension)
